items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I made some records with Jack that went very well in those days.

ctx.x: But he had all those big guys and let me just throw some of these names at you that we can kind of talk about. There's Keg Johnson, which was your friend and my friend. He was in "Tailspin", he was with Benny Carter. And did you do much for Tommy Dorsey? Jack Teagarden --
I made some records with Jack that went very well in those days. There's a Moonglow record under the

leadership of Benny Goodman. Pick-up band years ago before Goodman became a leader. Then made some pick-up records with another great trombone player, Red Norvo's leadership, Jack Jenney (PHONETIC). He was (inaudible).
